scope: Production admission, gathered/adopted view, coarse input and actual selected-world presentation metrics. This field map does not redefine other quiet-telemetry metrics or private experiment additions.

envelope.name: metric key below
envelope.values: exactly eight unsigned 64-bit integers; index order below
envelope.timestamp: mach_ns is CPU enqueue observation time, not GPU execution or presentation time. Embedded interval endpoints have their own meaning.
envelope.sequence: Producer attempt index; gaps can reflect loss and concurrent producers can enqueue out of sequence. Do not assume file order is global timestamp or operation order.
envelope.unknown: Zero frame/command identity can mean unscoped; UINT64_MAX (18446744073709551615) is the cleared-world source sentinel. A failed validity flag is unknown, never a measured zero.

unit_notes.duration_ns: elapsed wall nanoseconds, except explicitly named thread CPU
unit_notes.cumulative_count: monotonic owner-lifetime counter; use valid ordered deltas, not totals as per-frame work
unit_notes.identifiers: Opaque numeric identities, not pointers or globally unique IDs. Scope as specified below.

qualification.identity: Use enclosing session_id/frame_id/view tags and exact ordered timestamps. Command identity is (creation session, command_id), never command_id alone. main_group_command is published in the command creation session. A target with another creation session, inactive token or zero identity cannot join a current-session command. Logical groups, admission tickets, display frames, view sequences and drawable IDs are different units. Block serial is renderer-lifetime local: require a single identified main renderer within each compared session; it survives shader reload, not renderer replacement.
qualification.admission: Match each main_admission_block to one ordered unblock and observer by session/frame/block. Join its target tickets to main_group_command and actual command lifecycle/waits; ticket_blocks_this_group selects the blocking group. A truncated target list forbids complete blocker attribution. Phase is label-derived, not a shader/resource bottleneck. A group-command row means command allocation/reservation, not successful commit or completion. Required-main waits omit other utility/renderer waits; absence of a block row is not proof of no blocking.
qualification.preparation: Canonical ordinary-main policy allows two pending logical groups, each with up to three transactions; observation does not change those limits. Canonical immutable adoption follows admission. view_scene_gathered proves only reported container counts and owner existence. view_destination_generation is the sampled canIssueGeneration predicate for those exact backing generations. Neither establishes full pre-gate readiness or independent work. Join successful adopt/encode rows by session/frame/view sequence/group/epoch; they describe CPU wall spans, not exclusive CPU or GPU execution.
qualification.gather: Pair exactly one view_gather_begin with exactly one later view_scene_gathered in the same session/frame. Missing, duplicate or reversed endpoints invalidate that duration. The span includes capture housekeeping, shadow finishing/cache work, gathering and other pre-admission owner work; it is not exclusive culling CPU or immutable-ready time.
qualification.camera: Use the actual captured modelview components0..15 and projection16..31. Six view_camera_bits rows start at0,6,12,18,24,30; the final four slots are padded zero. Each 16-word identity starts14695981039346656037, XORs each u32 word in order then multiplies1099511628211 modulo2^64; it is word-wise, not byte-wise FNV. First/change observations require all six chunks, u32 range, finite-component flag and exact raw-bit reconstruction. FNV identities are secondary. First camera observation has previous_known0 and changed0. A hash alone cannot establish exact identity; missing chunks do not imply an unchanged camera.
qualification.input: input_dispatch records only coarse kind/times, no text, key codes or coordinates. SDL dispatch captures expected session; stale-session events are discarded. Input interval between consecutive views is (previous_view_latest_input_sequence,current_latest_input_sequence]. Complete every serial in that range. Latest event alone is not a causal certificate. Require an isolated controlled burst, stable exact preceding camera views and first changed view to attribute first camera response; otherwise report only processing-to-presentation association.
qualification.SDL_clock: For event_ns>0, sample>=event, after>=before and nonnegative subtraction: event Mach interval=[before-(sample-event),after-(sample-event)]. Otherwise event time is unknown. Add integer-nanosecond conversion/rounding allowance. The bracket bounds the sampled clock conversion, not hardware/OS event-generation uncertainty; SDL timestamp is not proven physical input time. Dispatch begin/end are separate Mach observations.
qualification.presentation_clock: For positive finite in-range host values and ordered Mach bracket, convert presentedTime P to Mach interval [P+before-CA,P+after-CA], allowing integer-nanosecond rounding and rejecting overflow/invalid ranges. Require drawable_host_clock host_clock_valid1 and drawable_presented presented_time_valid1. presentedTime comes from the actual addPresentedHandler drawable; callback_observed_Mach_ns is not presentation time. This is no physical panel scanout or hardware input-latency measurement.
qualification.actual_world: Join ui_background_source and ui_background_submission in the actual presentation observation frame, requiring selected1, noncleared source, consistent context/color/depth identities and generations, real_world_background1, surface_submitted1 and COMPLETE end state. Join drawable submit/source/clock/presented records by session/command/drawable/current frame, with source_matches1 and the same actual source identity. Map source_frame to the successfully adopted/encoded view and reconstructed camera. A retained world can intentionally have an older source_frame than the attempted/current frame; never substitute the newest camera for a missing, cleared or mismatched source.
qualification.memory: Memory is sparse at ordinary admission2 and blocked0/1 boundaries, throttled100ms per renderer; process task sample separately caches100ms. task_info_valid0 is unknown. Physical footprint, MTL currentAllocatedSize and unique registry-reported bytes have overlapping scopes: never add them. Frame pages are shared owner storage, not exclusive to a logical group; retired may be GPU-complete awaiting pruning. Each active/retired/available traversal caps1024 entries; truncation means incomplete byte sums. Counts remain total collection sizes. Frame-page rows have no boundary field: join by session/frame/block and the enclosing memory-observer interval, never block0 alone. Missing ordinary/blocked samples are unknown, not zero marginal memory.
qualification.observer_cost: Memory observer interval includes preceding task/stats/page reads and row publications, ending before its own final enqueue. task_info_sampling_ns is narrower and can be cached. Admission pre/post observer intervals include nested memory observation; use interval unions, never double-count nested spans. wrapper_wait_wall_ns measures the original wait loop; thread CPU is valid only with thread_CPU_valid1. Full app/frame comparisons include all observer execution, including final enqueue costs.
qualification.GPU_limits: Actual command GPU start/end are asynchronous completion envelopes, can overlap and contain stalls. Do not sum overlapping envelopes or call their union hardware busy time, occupancy, utilization, headroom or pass cost. Exact pass/resource limiting work needs independent supported native trace/counter/capture evidence. No counter or readiness fact can be inferred from a missing row.
qualification.loss_and_gates: The producer is bounded and lossy. Qualify cadence, admission, preparation, memory and input/presentation independently using complete rows for that measure, expected source/process/session, calibrated coverage, consistent display/quality/camera and actual workload. Consecutive eligible FRAME coverage does not prove complete metrics/commands/callbacks. Footer loss remains explicit; command cutoffs/pending callbacks cannot be manufactured as complete. Unknown/ineligible measures must not inherit another measure’s success.
qualification.OFF: Disabled entry paths start no diagnostic clock reads, task_info/stat/page traversals, camera bit capture, input timing or presentation handler allocation. Previously installed callbacks may still execute after stop, but session-qualified publication discards them. Existing rendering, admission limits, submission order and work remain. This source contract is not a claim that observer overhead is zero when enabled.
qualification.privacy: Version only authored labels/field metadata. Raw camera bits, private scene/resource identities, traces and input records stay local; no accounts, credentials, URLs, coordinates or user strings belong in a versioned example. Private experimental metrics require a separate pinned manifest; they are outside this production map.
